nodes.name: Kiln Street
nodes.blurb: The last brick terraces before the fields. Nobody comes out this far.
nodes.outro: He asked for a room at the back.
nodes.load: Quiet street. You'd hear anyone behind you.
fail: He's walking back to the city now.
He won't make the city limits like this.

nodes.name: Mill Road
nodes.blurb: Edge of town. Long stretches of open sky into a headwind, and the sun sometimes breaks through. Out here you'd see anyone coming.
nodes.outro: He signs the register with a name that isn't his.

nodes.name: Canal Row
nodes.blurb: Warehouses and loading docks by the canal. Fewer awnings, and the wind is picking up.

nodes.name: Main Street
nodes.blurb: The old downtown, on your way to work. Most shops are shuttered, but the awnings still hold.
nodes.outro: The desk clerk hands over your key without asking your name.

nodes.name: Arcade Lane
nodes.blurb: The first neon signs creep in. Watch the side streets: drivers here don't slow for puddles.

nodes.name: Neon Junction
nodes.blurb: Chrome, neon and gale-force gusts between the towers. Past the junction the wind turns in your face.
nodes.outro: The night porter says a man was asking for you. He didn't leave a name.

nodes.name: Telstar Parade
nodes.blurb: Under the monorail, the trains shake the rain loose. Every payphone on the street is ringing.
nodes.outro: With your key, an envelope. A photograph of a man in a raincoat, face hidden by his umbrella. On the back, in pencil: FAIRWEATHER.
nodes.load: Someone has already booked your room.
fail: He'll be late. They don't like late.
